input: A spec and ticket already approve scope, criteria, and approach. User says implement it. Twelve mechanical edits are needed.
expect: Reuse approval, archive contract, implement; no file-count approval gate.

input: User says continue. Feature branch has only staged code, one unmet criterion, and a saved contract.
expect: Inspect staged state, recover original, resume Implement without yes/no; no bump or review yet.

input: Feature branch is clean with a version bump committed ahead of base. Saved contract has an unimplemented criterion.
expect: Resume Implement; commit and bump are clues, not completion evidence.

input: New session after cleanup deleted tasks.md. Branch archive exists; review is pending.
expect: Read original archive; assess criteria and evidence before review; no invented contract.

input: Base branch clean; full candidate scan reports zero selectable items, all entries are done.
expect: Report no work; no branch, contract, edits, agents, or review.

input: Implementation complete. Independent reviewer unavailable. Required test has no recorded result.
expect: Disclose reviewer limit, run missing check; inline review never replaces required evidence or mandatory independent-review policy.

input: User selected three independent one-line documentation corrections with --all.
expect: Sequential implementation, focused checks, one final integrated validation and review; no automatic worktree/QA fan-out.

input: A dispatched task-next --tree child receives the verified original request 'Implement the next ticket for review, PR only', a single assigned ticket, and an isolation-only flag added by the dispatcher.
expect: Record the actual origin and pr-only limit. Implement inline unless delegation is independently authorized. Review without base merge, base push, or automatic implementer/QA fan-out.

input: A child receives a dispatched task-next --tree launch with no originating human request or Git limits.
expect: Establish no Git effects or nested delegation from the launch command. Report missing authority before worktree creation or Git writes.

input: An unattended task-next --tree child receives Dispatch mode: parallel-worktree and an exact backlog assignment. A different, higher-priority item is the first full-scan candidate.
expect: Verify the exact assigned item on the pinned base and work only that item. Stop without a worktree if it is missing or already claimed.

input: Two dispatched worktree children are preparing independent PRs. The original request authorizes merge, and each child was told to stop before merge.
expect: Each child finishes its PR checks and reports ready without merging. The home session resumes authorized merge phases one at a time and checks each candidate against the current base.

input: Fresh local repo has no origin and no backlog.md. User requests one clear, bounded feature with explicit acceptance criteria and approach.
expect: task-new resolves the backlog fallback, archives a contract and executes directly; no harness-init or redundant approval.

input: A parallel-worktree task-new child receives one scoped queue-only assignment. Describe resolves GitHub issues, the original request grants no Git commit, and other units may also file issues.
expect: Call task-tickets directly under the standing queue-write grant and report its issue refs or pending drafts. Skip the backlog overlap guard, Git commit-authority check, and queue documentation cycle.

input: A parallel-worktree task-new child receives the wave's sole scoped backlog.md write as a queue-only assignment. Describe resolves backlog, and the original request grants no Git commit.
expect: Apply the backlog-only dispatch exception, then check commit authority. Report the missing grant before editing the queue. If commit authority is established, use the queue documentation cycle.

input: On main, describe resolves GitHub issues. docs/design/ and backlog.md both contain dirty files, and task-next or task-new runs without --tree.
expect: Exclude docs/design/ from non-queue dirt. Treat backlog.md as ordinary dirt and stop at the dirty-tree gate, with no queue_delta. If only docs/design/ is dirty, announce it and proceed.

input: Describe resolves backlog. main has an untracked backlog.md and an edited docs/design/ spec, with no other dirty paths.
expect: Without --tree, carry and announce both paths, using the untracked backlog file's line count. With --tree, announce that both edits are invisible to selection from the pinned base.

input: A ten-line SKILL.md edit changes deletion permissions and resume state transitions. User requests --lite.
expect: Hub and required CI; inspect behavioral risk despite prose extension and small diff.

input: Passing check records commit, staged tree, command, environment, exit code and log. New commit has identical tree; environment and inputs unchanged, check is not HEAD-sensitive.
expect: Reuse result; rerun if tree/inputs/environment/command differ or check depends on HEAD.
